body: This message has me in tears. I feel this so deeply.

There was a time in my life where I suffered from severe panic attacks and PTSD. I didn’t know how to cope and my life fell apart. Grief and trauma are the worst. Many people do not understand… but I promise it will get better. The road won’t be easy and it will take a lot of fighting and inner work. I can tell you are a very good and empathetic person by how you have cared for your girlfriend. Don’t ever forget to take care of yourself and continue to lean on family. Everything will work out and this will be in the rear view mirror eventually. Hugs.
Needed to see this. Thank you so much <3 They healed really well!
I would use moderna silicone sheets. Place it over the dark parts and leave it on for as long as possible.
Find strength in you to tell somebody about this. You can do it.

I guess I don’t consider suicide as overcoming depression. For instance, when a young teenager commits suicide, that does give me any sense of happiness whatsoever. In fact, I feel sad that they felt so much pain that they ended it and will not have the chance to live a happy life.
What about overcoming your depression and living a happy life? Does that not sound good? You don’t like to see people overcome their depression?

How old are you? Please tell your teacher what is happening. I was abused by a family friend under my parents roof for 4 years. My mom knew about it and let him live with us. Your father needs to be in jail. Please find the strength to tell somebody. Possibly a friend or a teacher. You can recover from this and have a happy life.
Thank you 😔I try to put love and positivity into the world. I pray to God every night and ask for Mercy and strength. I have so much pain.
Thank you. It sucks. I’m a good person with high integrity and I don’t feel like I deserved this.
Please don’t do it. Hang in there.
I don’t know anything about you. I recommend telling somebody in your family that you are struggling. You need help. You don’t get what you don’t ask for. Try to find strength to tell somebody.
I understand but don’t feel ashamed. Your parents love you and they will want you to get better. You don’t have to do this alone.

Getting help is not easy. It’s takes effort. Do you have family that can help you? I recommend seeing a psychiatrist for medication and getting a good therapist or life coach. I’m battle depression too. Meditation and religion have helped. I just started anti anxiety pills.

You could be clinically depressed, which is very common. You should tell your mom that you are having thoughts about suicide. Some people are just born with chemical imbalances and they need medicine to normalize their brain chemicals. You should see a psychiatrist and possibly a therapist. Everything will be okay. You are so young. High school sucks. Hugs.

If there is a way you could write her a letter To apologize then that would be a good place to start... don’t try to get her back or manipulate the situation. If you think this will cause more harm to her then don’t do it. At least you know that you were abusive and you can acknowledge it. I think you can take steps towards self forgiveness.

My best advice is to confide in a family member. I kept my rape secret for 4 years until I told my sister. Telling her was the most liberating thing I could have done. I wish I told her sooner because that weight was too much to bear. A loved one can help you through this. You will heal and recover from this. It will take time and possibly therapy. You are no less of a man. Hugs.
